_comment: Prompt to correct-reaction pairs for Pale Raven Bird Time: 48 characters, 475 prompts. The source lists only the correct option, because the two wrong options are randomised in game.

_mechanics.whatItIs: In Part 1 Eshmel spends much of each story path disguised as the Pale Raven, a bird, and can be fed at the Pale Raven Perch.
_mechanics.unlock: Advance any story path in Part 1 until the main character reaches the capital; the Perch then becomes available.
_mechanics.partOneOnly: Feeding the Pale Raven is a Part 1 activity and is not available at all in Part 2, where other ways of bonding with Eshmel take over.
_mechanics.weekly: One feeding per game week, refreshing on Sundays.
_mechanics.cost: A vegetable item from the materials bag is required to start the minigame.
_mechanics.threeChoices: Every prompt offers three reactions and exactly one is correct. The two wrong reactions are always random, so this table lists the correct option rather than predicting the distractors.
_mechanics.result: Failing all three prompts gives a Bad result but still earns a little support; a Perfect result earns the most.
_mechanics.combatBonus: In ordinary combat Eshmel can appear at the moment of a killing blow and block all incoming damage, and the chance rises with support.
_mechanics.clashBonus: In Dungeon Clashes, when your side is low on total HP, Eshmel can appear and defeat the enemy party instantly.
_mechanics.supportBonus: Bird Time is also the route to unlocking an A rank support conversation between Eshmel and most characters recruitable in Part 1.

prompts.prompt: I will read you the masterpiece by my father Aeneus. It's powerful enough to move even your avian heart.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: In moments of reflection, a demon taunts me, telling me I have no talent.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm partial to birds' faces- not like fishes' with those soulless eyes.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Through the temples, I've been given so many story ideas!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: How I adore this city. You can sit back and witness the bustle, the confusion- the ecstasy!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Had I wings like yours, I could fly at once to any research subject I wanted.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I grew up in a home surrounded by natural beauty, where I awoke each morning to birdsong.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Poisonous plants will harm people, but they can be made into medicine.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My tattoos mark me as a member of the Har Hali clan.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You need agility to survive in the forests. I wonder, are you agile when you're in trees?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Orchel once saved my lif. It's only natural that I want to return the favor, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've been all over, doing work as a messenger for a temple. But I've never seen a bird like you until now.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I don't need to sleep on a bed. I can rest anywhere.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I know how to preserve meat by applying an herbal rub and smoking it.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm happy with my life now. There's no reason to worry about me.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You have a strangely penetrating gaze. Your eyes would be an advantage in battle.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Do you worship Balor? I used to long ago, but I don't these days.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's better to learn how to use a blade than sit around in a classroom learning stuff.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I don't know who my parents are, but I don't really care. Things are good now.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Birds eat fish, right? I'll catch a big one for you sometime!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: There's a horrible guy I know from my temple. I'm going to punch him if he treats me badly again.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I love sweets. How about I bring you my favorites sometime?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm pretty happy with my life now. But my heart goes out to my ol' street-orphan friends...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You live in the forest, right? So tell me... how do you feel about ghosts?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Ozin taught me how to defend myself. Now I want to be strong enough, so he doesn't have to worry!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Even if it gets kind boring, I can't complain if I've got a place to sleep and enough to eat.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I stole things before I worked for the temple. I'd get punished if caught and still have a scar.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: The land of Dagda is full of interesting things.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: People tell me I have a stern look much of the time.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My daughter is currently in a long slumber. I hope to be at her side by the time she awakens.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Your white appearance reminds me of someone very close to me.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like lending a hand to those already trying to help themselves.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm documenting all in this land to share with future generations.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Despite appearances, I carry more concerns than most people.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I enjoy writing fables. Are there any tales shared among birds?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Care to join me fishing? It's nice to spend time idly, casting a fishing line.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Do you detect anything... strange about how I look?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Looking at the clouds always is a balm for my hurt and heart.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: The spirits want to talk to you. They're... curious about you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like being alone in my solitude.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Death haunts me. Are you haunted by death?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It is wonderful fun, isn't it... What, can't you see who I'm speaking with?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I fear that my words enter the eat in strange ways. I am misunderstood... and avoided.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: When I look at someone, they in turn look away. It seems that I am forever feared.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have a strong dislike for insects. Could you chase off any who draw too close to me?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I would be grateful if you would pray with me, that wayward souls may move on to the next world.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If you see someone in trouble, you should help them.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Training's fun, but I get bored in a classroom. Who needs books to be strong, anyway?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Martial arts tightens my mind and stregthens my body!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: The people of the village were real nice to me, so I wanna try and make them happy.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Everyone treats me like a kid just 'cause I'm short.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I can't keep calm when someone picks a fight with me!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Everyone's always yelling at me to be quiet. Am I really that loud?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You've got weird eyes. Ya know, they kinda remind me of Anatolia's.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Maybe I got a little too into my training?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: When I think about the future, I always end up worrying about stuff I can't do anything about.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I can't fight as well as everybody else, but I can maybe useful in other ways, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like making sweets. Maybe I could make something sweet for you sometime.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I bought a cute accessory the other day! But it was cheap, and it broke the next day.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've been thinking about my next performance, and I think people would love it if we did a trick together!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm good at crafts. I ought to try making something with bird feathers, maybe.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I think taste is more important than looks when it comes to vegetables, don't you?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I saw a magician make a bird appear in their hand from nowhere! I want to try it.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It doesn't matter how long I'm gone, thinking of my family and hometown makes me feel so lonely.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Nasshim used to take care of me. He was so nice. I still think about him sometimes...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Being hungry can make ya sad. You ever need food, you let me know.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I can tell how a building is put together with just a glance.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Nothing personal, but you don't really look that tasty. You're all bones for one thing.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Back in the village, we hunted and ate sandworms.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Know what? I like you. How about if you join the Dadao Gang?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Anatolia's always hard on me. You think it's her way of flirting with me?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Everyone in the village is always hungry. I wanna make it so they can all eat whenever they want.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I can tell you're interested in me. I'm a good-lookin' guy, so I can't blame ya!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My parents are gone, but I don't really feel lonely. I'm stronger than anyone I know!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If I'd remained in the village, I could be holding a baby in my arms.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It can be wonderful traveling the outside world.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You're quite calm around humans. Aren't you afraid of creatures bigger than you?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm always drawn to people older than me. My first love was like that.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You've seen the world from up in the sky. I wish I spoke bird language.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Your eyes are so charming. I wonder how mine look to you?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm always a little wary of talking to people from the temples.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I love taking care of others. Do you think I could preen your feathers sometime?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have no idea what birds eat. Maybe you could let me try one of your meals sometime?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Our mission, the hopes of the villagers... It's all important, but so is protecting family, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I saw this couple the other day, and they had so much passion! Kinda made me jealous...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Ugh! Gummy, sticky, greasy... I just hate dirty things.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Dante's work is amazing! Here, let me read you something!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If I had wings? I'd travel the world and see everything this life has to offer.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've been working so harad at the company. Whew! I think I need a vacation.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You're pretty smart for a bird. Are you one of those spirits in disguise like in the stories!?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: One day, I'd love to be the main character of some grand adventure.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Father always said I was a fantastic swordsman. Couldn't ever impress him with axes, though...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Turns out, the person I like already has a partner... How will I ever recover...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You know, I do a little bit of writing myself. I should write something with you as the main character.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Doesn't being with me... bore you?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: There area times when I can't take my mind off the one I adore...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Sometimes when I read poetry, I swear it's almost like I'm listening to music.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Your eyes are so kind. They make me feel safe...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Love is a strange thing... Have you ever had feelings for someone?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I suddenly feel like crying...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: War and pain, fighting and hate... All of it just makes me sad... I'd like to avoid those things if I can.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Maybe the reason I'm drawn to you is because, like that person, you're hard to grasp...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Romance has always been a bit tough for me to grasp. Maybe a friend like you is all I need.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If you're ever hurt, come find me, and I'll heal you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: In the field, nice guys always die fast.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Now, if I could fly from battlefield to battlefield? Man, that would be the life.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Just because my ancestors were from Damascar doesn't mean I pray to Yu Phas too.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You know, I've always liked carving little wooden statues. Maybe, one day, I'll carve you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's not too hard to be a merc, really. Fly over a battlefield, and maybe you'll see some in action!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Sometimes, even when I'm not on the battlelfield, I feel this... tension in me, you know?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You're a strange one, aren't you? An animal that cares about living longer is usually more careful.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Launching a surprise attack is probably easier if you can fly, huh?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You're in the pink of health. Like you could survive anywhere.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Nosy people drive me up the wall. You know what I mean?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: How do you take care of your feathers? They're so pretty.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It feels great to soar in the sky, doesn't it? How high can you fly?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I go on long rides every now and then. Would you like to come along sometime?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I heard someone talking about me behind my back earlier. What should I do about that?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It must be scary to live out in the wild. Please call for me if you're ever going somewhere dangerous!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have nothing but happy memories of my parents. But I do get sad, knowing they live only in memory.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm trying to live up to the name of "Silver Maiden," and with Bucephalus, I'm sure that I will!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm confident in my abilities in battle. I should show you what I can do sometime!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Would you like to meet Bucephalus? It'd be fun if you two were friends!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Have you ever been to my home in Tellus? It's a wealthy county and has an easiness to it.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've got a secret under my eyes patch that related to my past. I won't tell you about it though.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Words like "repent", "regret", and "reform" are all strange to me. But I suspect you do all of that.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Rarities fetch a high price, which is why I like them. Not that you'd know about such things.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Have you read the War Chronicle of Hasdrubal? I assure you, its scenes will thrill you to the core!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's only a matter of time before you realize that I was the best leader of this whole era!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: No matter how many times you fail, your dream doesn't die until you do.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I was a fine specimen of a man in my youth. No matter where I went, people sang my praises!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I am brilliant, amazing, dashing, and more! And I'm a perfect general!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's harder to get a good night's sleep as I get older. I envy you juveniles and your deep sleep.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I despise a bland meal. I want a life of luxury. You must want that too, yes?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have a terrible scar that's hidden by my outfit. It's proof that I fight bravely.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My pegasus has a refined palate and kicks away any food that's not up to par.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Always conduct yourself well, or it reflects badly on your lord.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've traveled for years, so I learned how to amuse myself. Care to learn how to while away the time?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I used to serve a noble. But a terrible indicent led to his downfall.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If you value top quality, you develop an eye for it.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My pocket sare getting emptier, and so is my stomach. Maybe I'll just eat some bird food here...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I can tell if a bird's singing voice is truly beautiful or not.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I keep hearing about people getting married... Where is my ideal partner?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Caring for one's personal appearance is crucial.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My advice- make certain you're the only one to make the calls in battle.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: A lady socked me real hard a little earlier. That just means she was shy, yeah?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: There are only so many meals we can eat in our lifetimes. Best to eat what you want, yeah?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm one of the most seasoned mercenaries here! Do I have the look of a battle survivor?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: All this peace and quiet is making me sleepy. How about you do something to wake me up?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Are you living your life to the fullest? If not, why bother being alive at all!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like your determined look. Hey, you know you can count on the Unkillable Guzran, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Lots of people got to where they are today because of me. One merc is now imperial inspector!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I earned my nickname, Unkillable Guzran, one scar at a time. Pretty cool, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: The truth is- my true form is that of a bird. So I wonder, are you really a person?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm not very skilled at dealing with men. Could you help me out if one harasses me?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I don't leave much of an impression on people. But you're so beautiful I bet you do...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: When I'm fighting, I'll say some horrifying things. Like I did when I possessed those awful remains.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Everyone back at my village speaks in a very unique way. Do birds have accents or dialects?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's nice having family and friends to help when you're in trouble. Always treasure your friends, OK?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: A brown cow with a crowned brow! Ach, say that three times fast, why don't ya?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I used to hunt birds with my bow. Ha! Want to see if you can outfly one of my arrows?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'll lose all track of time when I'm practicing with my bow. So if you see me at night, give me a holler!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I wonder how I would have fared in the Heroic Games if I didn't have Ugo's Bow...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Do you know the Order of Mithras? I'd suggest that you steer clear of them.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's natural to help one's friends an also the weak. But it sometimes takes courage to do what's right.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Do you think we need someone to lead us? I believe in such an ideal, and I welcome your thoughts on it.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm a bit tired. Forgive me if I fall asleep.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Do you think it wrong to accept payment from a lord you're drawn to serve?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You bring a sort of calm atmosphere to a place. Mind if I linger here a little longer?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: What would you do if I said there's a venomous spider behind you? Let's practice. Drive it off... now!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Ha, you have an interesting face. I never get tired of seeing it.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm not that ill-tempered, really. I wonder if you'd like to be more sociable too.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I end up saying too much when talk turns to lords and their duties. Should I say less about it all?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My beloved steed, Rocinan, is aging very well. Do you think that when you see him?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You always seem to be alone. Don't you get lonely out there in the world, all by yourself?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've traveled all over the land. Have you visited lots of places too?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If someone settles down somewhere, a big home is best to house a big family, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I had a husband, you know. He died some time ago, but I wonder if he watches over me.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: What's it like if you get hit by heavy rain while you're flying?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have things I want to protect. Is there something that you want to protect?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: When you love your family and it all falls apart, that's about as bas as it gets, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Sometimes, you've got to get sneaky if you want to survive. I mean, when you really have to!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: When you do nothing but battle, you can end up feeling pretty frazzled...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I don't value money over things. But aren't there things you can't protect without money?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Nothin' better than smacking around nobodies when I'm annoyed.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You're not scared of me, which means you don't get how great I am.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: None of these grunts around here have a chance of beating me.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Doesn't matter who comes at me- they're no match for the great Majide, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: That damned Order of Mithras left me for dead.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If my Southern Cross Brigade crew had battled in the games, we would have won, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Prison cells are my home away from home. Next time I'm locked up, find me and we'll play a game!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Everyone knows the great Majide has the strength of 10 men.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'm bored as hell. Got a good move to show me?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I shoved a mouthy drunk real hard. Felt pretty good, I gotta admit.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I learned a lot living on a mountain, like hunting and blacksmithing. Good to have skills, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like fighting with my fists. Keeps me feeling free and nimble in battle. Get what I mean?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I'd like to call you something more than "bird." How's Birdlee? Nah, that's not right.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I want to add a new move to my wrestle-dancing. Have any great ideas?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I grew up thinking you had to marry the person who can defeat you in a fair fight. It's a dumb tradition, right? I'm tougher than the guys back home anyway.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Back home, I don't rank that high in importance, but as the chief's daughter, I'm singled out for marital challenges.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My third eldest brother is traveling the world like I am. Say hello if you see him. He loves animals.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I trained most days of my life, going up and down Mount Orgus. Want me to kick your perch in half?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You're always here alone. Did you leave your flock? I did something like that too. Let's be friends!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Something good is coming up soon. My gut is always right, you know!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My people use the behavior of animals as an omen for battle.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: City life is still strange to a forest-dweller like me. If I get lost in Dagsion, would you show me the way?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Birds have many meals each day, yes?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We of the Har Hali live in harmony with nature. You are not the first bird I would befriend.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: My skills did not live up to those of previous chiefs. Have I been of use to my people at all?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: A mere graze from our poison can fell a bird instantly. Stay well away during our hunts.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We must not isolate ourselves out of pride. That way is death.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: These disheveled feathers must make it hard to fly. I'll straighten them for you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Rule based on strength only chokes the people. I'm sure you would also feel suffocated under oppression.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I suspect no one could tarnish your wings. Keep true to your way of life. Let no one take you captive.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like eating sweet things. That surprises people.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Don't worry. I have no interest in hunting you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You have to learn a little bit about everything to grow.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: After I left my kingdom, I broke one of its laws by learning to write. Yu Phas will surely punish me.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: People rely on me a lot, but I have to admit it'd be nice if I could rely on others more.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I left my kingdom behind, but there are still many in Saramis who look up to me.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I studied hard to learn how to read and write. Do you think you could do that too?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've roved widely and welcome such long journeys. Do you migrate much?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Mercenaries are more selective about work than you'd think.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You remind us of the spirits of our homeland.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We have enjoyed seafood since our earliest days and would like to savor Dagdan specialties with you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We hope to take Lady Ultand as our queen, though some consider her rank in society too low for us...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We deem you worthy of our protection, so if you're ever in trouble, please let us handle it!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: You must visit our kingdom. We would feed and entertain you magnificently.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We are very fond of the people of Brigid. So if you see any, please tell us, alright?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We find ourselves bored at the moment. Can you perform any tricks?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: More of the people here grow to love us by the day. Is this the effect kings have on others?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: We are from Brigid, which is a kingdom that loves nature. So we enjoy our time with you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: To learn the ways of a foreign land, there's no better way than to mingle with it's people, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I like to give everyone cute little names. I hope it's cute anyway. Maybe it's kind of weird?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Don't you think Lord Solel is wonderful? He's so kind, amazing, and just plain great!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Mmm, roasted? Braised? Oh! Sorry, I didn't mean anything by it. You don't look tasty at all!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I never get tipsy, no matter how many mugs of suds I drink. How about you?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have a VERY healthy appetite. The pay I get from the temple can't cover my meals. Tragic, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I was born and raised at Lyoshan Fort. If you ever go there, watch out for all the ruffians!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I love spicy food more than anything. Too bad it always gets eaten up quick. Why is that, I wonder?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If I think someone's cute, I can't help calling them a fun name. I'm going to call you Li'l Birdie!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I grew up enjoying food at my dad's feasts with his friends. If I have a big party like that, want to come?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Be careful to to get too near me when I'm really hungry. You do look delicious, I'm sorry to say.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Birdsong makes everything better. It pairs especially well with a fine drink.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Some say that belief is the same as not thinking. I disagree.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: When my body has perished, and I float as a soul, let's frolic in the sky.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: There is a saying that a bird flown from the coop is truly still close to home.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Practicing silence was part of my training. How about you give it a try?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: To live or die... To be tipsy or sober... Therse are similar states in a fleeing world.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I have the odor of hitting the bottles too heavily. Yet I don't mind.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If birds have hearts, I wonder what kind beats under those feathers of yours.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: To think that I've put myself in the care of such a group of people. Fate is strange, isn't it?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I've heard of a monstrous bird who turned perfectly good wine inot poison. I trust that's not you?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: There's no way I can give up on pillaging now! You know how many years I've been at it?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: It's common sense to pick off the weaklings in battle. You look like easy prey to me!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Got parents? If you don't, you'd fit in with me and my pals just fine. You could join our bandit crew!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: The mountains are like home to me. I shold build me and my pals a castle up there, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Weaklings like you end up as dinner. So try to fly extra-high so the arrows don't get you.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: The guys in the Gaia Brigade left me for dead as soon as we lost our battle in the games. Cruel, huh?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: I thought I could get anything I want through plunder and fighting. But how can I get myself a family...

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: Good idea not fighting anyone who looks too dangerous. Whoever lasts longest... wins, right?

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: If anyone gets robbed or snuffed out... they shouldn't be so weak! Fight harder, that's what I say!

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide

prompts.prompt: People think bandits eat nothin' but meat. It's vegetables all the way with me. Keep that in mind.

sources.label: IGN - Pale Raven Bird Time Guide
